# An option belongs to the level that declares it: the props on `output` are
# what every target accepts, a language's are on the language node and a
# platform's on the platform node. Guards the tier split -- a platform option
# written on another platform, or a language's written on a platform, is an
# unknown prop rather than a name some merged schema happened to hold.
sngl check ok.sngl
stdout 'ok'

! sngl check platform_leak.sngl
stderr 'unknown prop "stylesheet" on component bubbletea'

! sngl check lang_leak.sngl
stderr 'unknown prop "goVersion" on component html'

-- ok.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

output(name="Demo", icon="favicon.png") {
    none {
        html(stylesheet="app.css")
    }
    go(goVersion="1.23") {
        bubbletea()
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- platform_leak.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea(stylesheet="app.css")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- lang_leak.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

output {
    none {
        html(goVersion="1.23")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="hello")
}

app.window {
    main
}
